classification: engineering capability; not return or admission evidence
implemented: canonical FUTURE asset and market identities
first-notice and last-trade exit buffers counted in supplied exchange sessions
mandatory roll to the immediate next expiry or fail-closed flatten
hard rejection of generic crypto fee and calendar fallbacks

invariants.roll_direction: immediate next listed expiry only; never skip a lineage gap
invariants.deadline: earliest of first-notice and last-trade session buffers
invariants.future_data: metadata or liquidity available after decision raises LookaheadError
invariants.missing_successor: mandatory exit flattens when immediate successor is unavailable
invariants.missing_liquidity: volume roll holds; limit-state execution blocks

not_implemented: venue and product fee, exchange, initial-margin and maintenance-margin schedules
futures broker routing or live order reconciliation
claim_boundary: These primitives prevent several classes of futures lifecycle leakage and unsafe fallback. They do not make any existing ETF proxy sleeve a futures sleeve and do not qualify a strategy for admission.
